method: Map mods: RePoE 3.30 area prefixes/suffixes with positive spawn weight on low/mid/top/uber tier maps (or default). White/yellow/red tiers use PoB map affixes where PoB has one; other mods and all T17 mods are translated into PoB enemy mods, player custom modifiers or enemy penetration. Not modelled mechanics are kept as danger axes.
disclaimer: Numeric model for PoB calculations, not a game test. Roll = worst case of the range. Layout, density, ground effects, reflect, on-death effects and league content are not calculated.

normal.label: Normal map monster
normal.pob_convention: PoB "No": generic physical hit = monsterDamageTable[level] * 1.5; no resistances (level comes from the map tier here).

magic.label: Magic map monster
magic.pob_convention: PoB "No": generic physical hit = monsterDamageTable[level] * 1.5; no resistances (level comes from the map tier here).

rare.label: Rare map monster
rare.pob_convention: PoB "No": generic physical hit = monsterDamageTable[level] * 1.5; no resistances (level comes from the map tier here).

unique.label: Unique map monster (not the map boss)
unique.pob_convention: PoB "No": generic physical hit = monsterDamageTable[level] * 1.5; no resistances (level comes from the map tier here).

map_boss.label: Map boss (PoB Standard Boss average)
map_boss.pob_convention: PoB "Standard Boss": each of Phys/Light/Cold/Fire = table * 1.5 * stdBossDPSMult, chaos = that / 2.5; 40% elemental / 25% chaos resistance; ailment threshold x488 more.
map_boss.note: PoB averages boss skills into one hit; rarity multipliers are not stacked on top. Real map bosses vary widely.

pinnacle.label: Pinnacle / Guardian boss, generic hit
pinnacle.pob_convention: PoB "Guardian/Pinnacle": table[84] * 1.5 * pinnacleBossDPSMult per type, 3% elemental penetration, 50/30 resistances, armour/evasion scaled by the boss mean.

uber.label: Uber pinnacle boss, generic hit
uber.pob_convention: PoB "Uber Pinnacle": table[85] * 1.5 * uberBossDPSMult per type, chaos / 4, 8% elemental penetration, 50/30 resistances and 70% less damage taken.
